description: Unified symptom ontology for SymptoGraph-LLM. Harmonises PHQ-9, GAD-7 and additional clinically grounded concepts available in the open datasets. Used as the concept bottleneck label space (novelty N1).

symptoms.name: anhedonia
symptoms.definition: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

symptoms.name: depressed_mood
symptoms.definition: Feeling down, depressed or sad

symptoms.name: sleep_disturbance
symptoms.definition: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much

symptoms.name: fatigue
symptoms.definition: Feeling tired or having little energy

symptoms.name: appetite_change
symptoms.definition: Poor appetite or overeating

symptoms.name: worthlessness_guilt
symptoms.definition: Feeling bad about yourself, a failure, or that you have let people down

symptoms.name: concentration_problems
symptoms.definition: Trouble concentrating, remembering or thinking clearly

symptoms.name: psychomotor_change
symptoms.definition: Moving or speaking slowly, or being fidgety and restless

symptoms.name: suicidal_thoughts
symptoms.definition: Thoughts of being better off dead or of hurting yourself

symptoms.name: nervousness
symptoms.definition: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge

symptoms.name: uncontrollable_worry
symptoms.definition: Not being able to stop or control worrying

symptoms.name: excessive_worry
symptoms.definition: Worrying too much about different things

symptoms.name: trouble_relaxing
symptoms.definition: Trouble relaxing

symptoms.name: restlessness
symptoms.definition: Being so restless that it is hard to sit still

symptoms.name: irritability
symptoms.definition: Becoming easily annoyed, angry or irritable

symptoms.name: fear_apprehension
symptoms.definition: Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

symptoms.name: hopelessness
symptoms.definition: Belief that the future holds nothing good and cannot improve

symptoms.name: emptiness
symptoms.definition: Feeling hollow, numb or empty inside (DSM-5 MDD criterion A1 descriptor)

symptoms.name: loneliness
symptoms.definition: Feeling alone, disconnected or without companionship

symptoms.name: low_self_esteem
symptoms.definition: Persistently negative evaluation of one's own worth or ability

symptoms.name: thwarted_belongingness
symptoms.definition: Unmet need to belong; social alienation (interpersonal theory of suicide)

symptoms.name: perceived_burdensomeness
symptoms.definition: Belief that one is a liability or burden to others

exhaustive_sources.comment: Sources whose annotation scheme is exhaustive over its own label set, so an absent label means the symptom is genuinely absent (0) rather than unknown (-1).
